records.text: Citing the UVU independent review, Owens said an unidentified fire captain met Charlie Kirk at the hospital and performed CPR. She thought the captain was from fire station two in Orem, but said not to quote her and that it might have been Provo.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I'm going to have to put a bounty up on it, aren't I? Information pertaining to who the fire captain was who performed CPR. ... On Charlie (Charlie Kirk) when he arrived to the hospital, met them at the hospital, according to the UVU independent review. ... There was a fire captain. I'd like to know who that fire captain was. We all learned from the reports that they were from fire station two, I believe. ... Don't quote me on that, but something two. I think it was it was fire station two in Orem. ... Maybe it was Provo. But the point is, is we don't know who that fire captain is who performed CPR, and we find it to be very odd that neither Frank Turek in his many iterations of what happened, nor Brian Harpole in his super fantastic story of all that he did mentioned a fire captain who gave CPR.

records.text: Owens said she found it very odd that neither Frank Turek nor Brian Harpole mentioned the fire captain who performed CPR on Charlie Kirk.

records.text: Owens said she was told the fire-captain information was intentionally being hushed, did not know why, and requested direct knowledge rather than guesses based on research.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I am told that this information is intentionally. ... being hushed. And I can't figure out why, because that person would be a hero. You try to save Charlie Kirk's life. ... I can't figure out why they are trying to keep this information locked down. So please email us if you know more tips at CandaceOwens.com. Again, we want someone with direct knowledge, not people that are guessing based off of research.
